summary: Appointment of sole arbitrator under s.11(6); challenge to government-appointed arbitrator under s.12(5); Seventh Schedule conflict - government servant as arbitrator; Article 299 contract validity irrelevant; reliance on Perkins Eastman; arbitration clause invalid; petition allowed.
legal_provisions_cited: Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 s.11(6), s.12(5)
Article 299 of the Constitution of India
final_judgment: Petition allowed; Sole Arbitrator to be appointed under Section 11(6).
